description: The Tartan Army is the collective name for supporters of the Scotland national football team. The name, derived from tartan, a traditional symbol of Scotland, has been widely used since 1970s and refers to the travelling support that follows the national team at home and abroad. The group is known for its colourful displays, songs, large-scale tournament followings and charitable activities, and has developed a reputation as one of football's most distinctive supporter groups.
